subject: Pikolumi: public Kids advertising practices and child-mode SDK data disclosures
body:
Pikolumi (com.seifelmoulouk.pikolumi), ages 2–11; banners/interstitials; production held, test ads only. Flutter google_mobile_ads 9.1.0: Android GMA25.4.0/UMP4.0.0, iOS GMA13.11.0/UMP3.1.0; no mediation. Child/G before init, non-personalized requests, UMP under-age=true; no AD_ID/AdServices permissions or ATT. Publisher ID disabled: Android after init (required), iOS before.
Please provide:
1) Public Kids practices proving human age review of creatives before serving, for Apple §1.3.
2) Exact init/request data, purposes/recipients: IP/location, ads/interactions/diagnostics, AAID/IDFA, IDFV, Android/AppSet/SDK instance IDs.
3) Is Android publisher ID generated/sent before disabling on fresh install? Protections on older Android?
4) Apple Privacy/Play Data Safety linkage/tracking/sharing disclosures for these versions; Android docs describe 25.5, not 25.4.
5) Kids ad click-through/external-navigation safeguards.
Contact: rahmani@seifelmoulouk.com. Full details available.
followUpNotice: Thanks for contacting us. We'll follow up with you only if we need more information or have additional information to share.
replyDestination: Signed-in AdMob login email; public contact supplied in request body
